honesty: Forward/SHADOW. NET POINTS is the headline (win-rate sits beside it, never alone). Expectancy bars whose 95% CI crosses 0 are UNPROVEN (n>=30 candidate) and shown muted; n<30 is DESCRIPTIVE; negative-CI tracks show their real DOWN equity curve.
